title: Understanding the Logistic Regression Model
text: The logistic regression model is given by the equation $$P(Y=1|x)=\operatorname{\sigma}\left(\theta_1 hue+\theta_2 abv\right)$$. Here, sigma represents the sigmoid function, which is defined as $$sigma(z)=\frac{1}{1+e^{\left(-z\right)}}$$.

title: Calculate the Linear Combination
text: Substitute the values of hue and abv into the linear combination $$\theta_1 hue+\theta_2 abv$$. Given that $$hat_{\theta}=(2,1)T**$$, $$hue=\frac{1}{4}$$, and $$abv=-2$$, calculate the expression $$2\frac{1}{4}+1\left(-2\right)$$.

title: Evaluate the Linear Combination
text: Calculate the value of the linear combination $$2\frac{1}{4}+1\left(-2\right)$$.

title: Apply the Sigmoid Function
text: Now that you have the linear combination value, apply the sigmoid function to find the probability. Use the formula $$sigma(z)=\frac{1}{1+e^{\left(-z\right)}}$$ where $$z$$ is the linear combination you calculated.

title: Calculate the Probability
text: Using the linear combination value $$z=-1.5$$, calculate the probability gamma using the sigmoid function: $$gamma=\frac{1}{1+e^{\left(-\left(-1.5\right)\right)}}$$.

title: Select the Correct Probability
text: Based on your calculation, select the correct probability value for gamma from the given choices.
